source.description: Complete translation of all 27 original paragraphs into fully vocalized Modern Standard Arabic. Dates, quantities, units and identifiers are rendered as spoken Arabic with the original values, including A-17 and E.W. English context determines the evening return and radio times. The authored shadda-before-vowel order is preserved for deterministic replay. AI editorial review against the original story and factual details.

support.notes: Frontend audit: 129 spans, 339 utterances, max 194 tokens, zero unknown tokens/words; token/stress SHA-256 1f5bce0f95699c495b17ec67838ba5f3269bbd2fb631499ab40b26eebe8b3194. CATT runs CPU/WASM on both adapters; WebGPU capability applies only to the acoustic ONNX graph.

settings.frontend: Pinned Tiny Voca Arabic frontend plus browser CATT v2 ED diacritizer; number expansion and the original sentence/clause fitting policy.
settings.waveform: Stock Tiny Voca source-filter output; one 120 ms silence between utterances and one 0.99 peak cap per source span.
